extensionDescription.message: Pick an X post to archive its metadata and media into your local folder.

tipArchive.message: Archive this post and its media

tipAlreadyArchived.message: Already archived: open the archive page

tipDelete.message: Delete this archive: text, counts, media and post data

tipConfirmDelete.message: Click again to delete. Nothing can be recovered.

tipDeleteShared.message: Another post uses a file from this archive too. Deletion refused.

errorUnreachable.message: The archiving service does not answer. Open the application folder and run DEMARRER.cmd.

errorStillDown.message: The service still does not answer. Open http://127.0.0.1:18765 to see why.

errorStartRefused.message: The archiving service could not start. Close it if it is already open, then try again.

errorNotInstalled.message: Automatic start is not set up. Run INSTALLER D ABORD.cmd once, in the application folder.

errorNotPaired.message: Open the archive page (http://127.0.0.1:18765) and connect the extension.

errorPairAgain.message: Open the archive page and connect the extension again.

errorRefused.message: The archiving service refused the request.

errorBadUrl.message: Open an X post, or paste its address.

errorNoSession.message: Sign in to X in this browser, then try again.

popupIntro.message: Text, media and counts in your local folder.

popupRepliesHint.message: This choice also applies to the button under posts and to right-click.

popupRefresh.message: Read the counts again for a post already archived

popupQueued.message: Added to the queue. The download happens locally.

errorCompanionRequired.message: Open the Archivage X companion app on this Mac, then try again.
